name: openJiuwen
desc: Openly published agent platform, core of Huawei's AgentArts
desc_zh: 华为云开源的智能体平台，与智果 AgentArts 同源
solves: Building production agents from scratch means rebuilding runtime, memory and tooling. openJiuwen ships those parts as openly published code.
solves_zh: 从零搭生产级智能体，要自己写运行时、记忆和工具链。它把这些做成开源组件，拿走就能改。
best_for: A team wants an agent platform it can run on its own servers and modify freely.
best_for_zh: 团队要一个能部署在自己服务器上、代码可以随便改的智能体平台的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Huawei Cloud newsroom list (https://www.huaweicloud.com/news.html) and https）。 DATE NEEDS REVIEW: the dated official sentence says it 'has come online' on 2026-06-05, but the GitHub organisation openJiuwen-ai holds repositories (agent-core, agent-studio, agent-protocol, deepsearch, docs) created on 2026-02-26, so the code may have been public earlier. No official sentence carrying an earlier date was found. It is the open-source sibling of the ledger entry 智果 AgentArts@2025-06-01 (the release says the kernel is over 90% the same). The same release announces the PUBLIC BETA of 智果 AgentArts on 2026-06-05 ('华为云 智果（AgentArts）企业级智能体平台 全面践行Harness工程' under the heading '公测智果AgentArts企业级智能体平台，并同步贡献开源'), which is later than the 2025-06-01 date in the ledger — flagged in report.md. openjiuwen.com is a JS-rendered single-page app: HTTP 200 with title 'openJiuwen' and no readable body text without a browser. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：入库核对：GitHub 组织 openJiuwen-ai 的公开仓库创建于 2026-02-26，但最早的发布版本（agent-core v0.1.14）是 2026-06-05，与官方发布日一致，说明仓库在发布前并未公开；日期维持 2026-06-05。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.huaweicloud.com/news/2026/20260605100619686.html
